nodes.label: Discount Credit Category Locking
nodes.rationale: Domestic credits (₹500) locked to domestic bookings only; international credits (₹5,000) locked to international bookings only. Prevents cross-category misuse. Maximum one DC per person per tour booking. Enforced via exact error messages at checkout.

nodes.label: Explicit Tour Category (Replaces Destination Heuristic)
nodes.rationale: Replaced fragile destination-string heuristic (checking for 'india', 'west bengal', 'odisha') with explicit tour.category field. Eliminates false classification and supports clean category-locking enforcement.

nodes.label: Plan Normalization Design
nodes.rationale: Centralizes plan definitions to ALL_PLANS from siteData.ts, removing duplicated PLAN_CREDITS/PLAN_PRICES/PLAN_TYPES maps across demoWalletService and DashboardPage. Single source of truth reduces drift between components.

nodes.label: Data Migration Risk for Legacy Credits
nodes.rationale: Existing mock users may have undifferentiated discount_credits. Design decision: treat legacy balance as Domestic Discount Credits to avoid breaking existing users, or reset demo data.
